findings.detail: no HTML pages could be fetched (site down, blocked or wrong URL)
findings.fix: Check the URL, and that the server/CDN doesn't block normal crawlers
Add JSON-LD for LocalBusiness (see schema/ templates)
findings.how: Yoast/Rank Math → Settings → Site representation (Organisation / Local business). For a salon: Rank Math Local SEO module or the Yoast Local SEO add-on sets the LocalBusiness subtype, hours and geo. Otherwise paste JSON-LD with a code-snippets plugin (WPCode).

findings.fix: Generate an XML sitemap and submit it in GSC/Bing
findings.how: Yoast → Settings → Site features → XML sitemaps on. Submit /sitemap_index.xml in Search Console and Bing.
Yoast → Tools → File editor, or upload robots.txt to the web root.

findings.fix: Use one exact business name everywhere (site, GBP, directories, schema)
findings.how: Settings → General → Site Title, plus Yoast → Site representation → Organisation name.

findings.fix: Add an FAQ / Q&A section answering real customer questions (visible text, not just schema)
findings.how: Add an FAQ section (Elementor Accordion). It's visible text for AI answers; FAQ rich results no longer show.

findings.fix: Optional: publish /llms.txt (cheap, low evidence of impact)
findings.how: Yoast (v25+) and Rank Math can generate llms.txt, or upload a file to the web root via SFTP (Cloudways → Application → Access details).
